The Primal Hunter 15: A LitRPG Adventure

Zogarth (Author), Travis Baldree (Narrator), Aethon Audio (Publisher) & 0 more Format: Audible Audiobook
4.7 4.7 out of 5 stars (6,085)
Book 15 of 17: The Primal Hunter
Sorry, there was a problem loading this page.Try again.
See all formats and editions

The aftermath of the confrontation with Yip of Yore and Ell’Hakan still lingers as the fight for the Milky Way Galaxy approaches its end.

With the biggest threats dealt with, only the Holy Church and its schemes, as well as whatever remnants of Ell’Hakan’s faction, remain active threats before the galaxy is truly claimed.

Once everything is concluded and the galaxy is in a (relatively) stable state, Jake looks beyond his own galaxy, as he has many places in the universe he’s been looking forward to visiting.

By what is surely sheer coincidence, the Order of the Malefic Viper also happens to be planning a diplomatic mission to the Pantheon of Life, and who’s more qualified to be the mortal representative in such an important endeavor than the Chosen of the Malefic One himself?

Because Jake had always proven himself to be a real savant when it comes to diplomacy and won’t just spend the majority of his time there doing alchemy and invading their hunting grounds... right?

Book 15 of the hit Primal Hunter LitRPG Series is here. Grab your copy today!

About the Series: Experience an Apocalypse LitRPG with levels, classes, professions, skills, dungeons, loot, and all of the great traits of Progression Fantasy and LitRPG that you've come to expect. Follow Jake as he explores this new vast multiverse filled with challenges and opportunities. As he grows in power and slowly transforms from a bored office worker to a true apex hunter.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Back To Hunting And Class Progress!
    Reviewed in Australia on 1 April 2026
    Format: Kindle
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Another enjoyable entry. Following the defeat of Yip Of Yore and his chosen Jake has to arrange the governance of the Milky Way. Fortunately that is what subordinates are fore. Plenty of action and hunting and Jake begins to lay the groundwork for B-grade. A new cute critter helps him out and will become important in future entries. There is movement on the relationship front to the amusement of those in the know. Diplomatic discussions are going on in the background and it looks like Jake will get a great new growth bow to replace the one damaged in the last entry. I particularly liked the hunting grounds arc. I'm looking forward to the dinner plus one, laughs incoming. It is also nice to see how the secondary characters are doing.

    2 out of 5 stars
    Read the first half. Skip the second half.
    Reviewed in Australia on 7 April 2026
    Format: Kindle
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I get that is is published as a web series. So a certain amount of story drag on is to be expected. But this book takes it to extremes. First 40% of the book is basically 2 fight scenes. Second half of the book just feels like one fight scene on repeat. Starting to feel like the author is running out of material and just milking the cash cow. I enjoyed this series because it would have some politics and story telling. Now it just "shoot arrow, shoot diffrent arrow, shoot arrow again" Stop with the massively long fight scenes as page filler.
